topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I was so sure this was going to be my breakthrough, the novel solution the world had been waiting for. I had put countless hours into refining the design, testing it, making sure every detail was just right. I imagined the patents, the recognition, the possibility of changing things for the better. Then, the search, the one final step before submitting my application, and there it was—a patent, almost identical, already claimed. I can't shake the image of those documents, the dates, the names, staring back at me. It’s like I’ve hit an invisible wall, a barrier I didn’t see coming. Now, I find myself questioning every step, every choice, wondering what to do next.
